name: Potential Binary Or Script Dropper Via PowerShell
description: Detects PowerShell creating a binary executable or a script file.
author: GAI_CTI
false_positives: False positives will differ depending on the environment and scripts used. Apply additional filters accordingly.
query: ((process.executable:(*\\powershell.exe OR *\\pwsh.exe)) AND (file.path:(*.bat OR *.chm OR *.cmd OR *.com OR *.dll OR *.exe OR *.hta OR *.jar OR *.js OR *.ocx OR *.scr OR *.sys OR *.vbe OR *.vbs OR *.wsf))) AND (NOT ((file.path:C\:\\Users\\* AND file.path:*\\AppData\\Local\\Temp\\* AND (file.path:(*.dll OR *.exe))) OR ((file.path:(C\:\\Windows\\Temp\\* OR C\:\\Windows\\SystemTemp\\*)) AND (file.path:(*.dll OR *.exe)))))
